Create choropleth maps showing median sales prices and numbers of sales 
by census tract

```{r set up}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)
library(urbnthemes)
#devtools::install_github("UrbanInstitute/urbnmapr")
library(urbnmapr)
set_urbn_defaults(style = "map")
library(openxlsx)
library(haven)
```

```{r define colors}

divergent_scale41 <- c("#CA5800","#FDBF11","#FDD870","#FFF2CF","#CFE8F3")
```

```{r load shapefiles}
water <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Waterbodies_2023/Waterbodies_2023.shp") %>%
  mutate(water = "Waterways")

national_parks <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/National_Parks/National_Parks.shp") %>%
  mutate(parks = "National Parks")

roads <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Roads/Roads.shp")

tract_shape <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Census_Tracts_in_2020/Census_Tracts_in_2020.shp") |> 
  select(GEOID)

ward_shape <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Ward_-_2022/Ward_-_2022.shp")

#re-attach geometry to RFK tracts
rfk_shape <- tract_shape %>%
  mutate(GEOID=as.numeric(GEOID)) %>%
  select(GEOID) %>%
  left_join(rfk_tracts, by = "GEOID")

#shape file with only RFK area
rfk_only_shape <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(rfk_group == 1)

#shape file with only RFK tract
rfk_only_tract <- rfk_only_shape %>% filter(GEOID == "11001006804")

#confirm CRS of census tract date
st_crs(ward_shape)$epsg

#create sf object with stadium coordinates
stadium_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(lon = -76.9718667, lat = 38.8898532), coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

#join sales data to tract shapefile, calculate change vars
sales_tract_sf <- left_join(tract_shape, sales_tract, by = c("GEOID" = "Geo2020")) |>
  mutate(r_chg_mprice_sf_10yr = 100 * ( ( r_mprice_sf_2025 / r_mprice_sf_2015 ) - 1 )) |>
  mutate(r_chg_mprice_sf_20yr = 100 * ( ( r_mprice_sf_2025 / r_mprice_sf_2005 ) -  1 )) |>
  mutate(r_chg_mprice_condo_10yr = 100 * ( ( r_mprice_condo_2025 / r_mprice_condo_2015 ) - 1 )) |>
  mutate(r_chg_mprice_condo_20yr = 100 * ( ( r_mprice_condo_2025 / r_mprice_condo_2005 ) - 1 ))

sales_tract_sf$r_chg_mprice_sf_10yr
sales_tract_sf$r_chg_mprice_sf_20yr
sales_tract_sf$r_chg_mprice_condo_10yr
sales_tract_sf$r_chg_mprice_condo_20yr

#DC Coordinates
dccoords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(ward_shape)))

dcymin = min(dccoords$Y)
dcymax = max(dccoords$Y)
dcxmin = min(dccoords$X)
dcxmax = max(dccoords$X)

#for outlines of the RFK areas
west_outline <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(west_of_anacostia == 1)

east_outline <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(east_of_anacostia == 1)

#for outlines of the RFK areas
west_outline_outer <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(west_of_anacostia == 1) %>%
  group_by(rfk_sub_group) %>%
  summarise()

east_outline_outer <- rfk_shape %>%
  filter(east_of_anacostia == 1) %>%
  group_by(rfk_sub_group)%>%
  summarise()
```

```{r create maps}

#function for creating price maps
price_map <- function( mapvar, legend_label, break_pts, color_scale ) {

currency_labels <- scales::label_currency(accuracy = 1)(break_pts)
thousands_labels <- scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1)(break_pts)

break_pts_labels <- c(
  paste("Under", currency_labels[1]), 
  paste(currency_labels[1], "-", thousands_labels[2]), 
  paste(currency_labels[2], "-", thousands_labels[3]), 
  paste(currency_labels[3], "-", thousands_labels[4]), 
  paste("Over", currency_labels[4])
)

#call main map making function
make_map(mapvar, legend_label, break_pts, color_scale, break_pts_labels)

}

#function for creating percentage maps
percent_map <- function( mapvar, legend_label, break_pts, color_scale ) {

percent_labels <- scales::label_percent(scale = 1)(break_pts)
thousands_labels <- scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1)(break_pts)

break_pts_labels <- c(
  paste("Less than", percent_labels[1]), 
  paste(thousands_labels[1], "to", percent_labels[2]), 
  paste(thousands_labels[2], "to", percent_labels[3]), 
  paste(thousands_labels[3], "to", percent_labels[4]), 
  paste("Greater than", percent_labels[4])
)

#call main map making function
make_map(mapvar, legend_label, break_pts, color_scale, break_pts_labels)

}

#main map making function
make_map <- function(mapvar, legend_label, break_pts, color_scale, break_pts_labels) {

NA_label <- "Data unavailable"

# Combine  label vector with the hard coded NA label
all_labels <- c(break_pts_labels, NA_label)

# Pre-bin continuous data and explicitly name NA values
sales_tract_sf_binned <- sales_tract_sf %>%
  mutate(
    # Create the initial 5 bins
    price_bin = cut(
      get(mapvar),
      breaks = c(-Inf, break_pts, Inf),
      labels = break_pts_labels,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    # Convert NA values into an explicit 6th category level
    price_bin = fct_na_value_to_level(price_bin, level = NA_label)
  )

# Map the custom NA color inside scale_fill_manual
map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sales_tract_sf_binned, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = price_bin), color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = west_outline, aes(color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA, size = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = east_outline, aes(color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA, size = 0.5) +
  # Display a star at stadium coordinates
  geom_sf(data = stadium_sf, aes(geometry = geometry, color = "RFK Stadium"), shape = "\u2605", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = legend_label,
    values = setNames( c(color_scale, NA_color), all_labels ),
    drop = FALSE 
  ) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "RFK East" = rfk_east_color,
      "RFK West" = rfk_west_color,
      "RFK Stadium" = rfk_stadium_star_color
    ),
    limits = c("RFK East", "RFK West", "RFK Stadium"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.text = element_text(vjust = 0.5) # Force vertical text center alignment
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(dcxmin, dcxmax),
    ylim = c(dcymin, dcymax),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  annotation_scale(unit_category = "imperial")

ggsave(filename = paste0("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/sales maps/", mapvar, ".png" ),
       plot = map,
       device = "png",
       height = 5,
       width = 8.5,
       dpi = 1000)

}

price_map("r_mprice_sf_2025","Median sales price, 2025 ($ 2025)",c( 500000, 775000, 1000000, 1500000 ),blue_scale5)
price_map("r_mprice_sf_2015","Median sales price, 2015 ($ 2025)",c( 500000, 775000, 1000000, 1500000 ),blue_scale5)

price_map("r_mprice_condo_2025","Median sales price, 2025 ($ 2025)",c( 300000, 400000, 500000, 600000 ),blue_scale5)
price_map("r_mprice_condo_2015","Median sales price, 2015 ($ 2025)",c( 300000, 400000, 500000, 600000 ),blue_scale5)

percent_map("r_chg_mprice_sf_10yr","Change in median sales price, 2015 - 2025", c(-10,0,10,20), divergent_scale24)
percent_map("r_chg_mprice_sf_20yr","Change in median sales price, 2005 - 2025", c(0,10,20,30), blue_scale5)

percent_map("r_chg_mprice_condo_10yr","Change in median sales price, 2015 - 2025", c(-30,-20,-10,0), divergent_scale41)
percent_map("r_chg_mprice_condo_20yr","Change in median sales price, 2005 - 2025", c(-30,-20,-10,0), divergent_scale41)

```
